dish: bun bo Hue, banh khoai, Hue royal cuisine
w: Eden Center's Hue-royal-cuisine specialist under the clock tower, plating central-Vietnamese rarities (bun bo Hue, banh khoai) seldom found in the DC area. The Washington Post's Tim Carman reviewed it as 'Eden Center's newest jewel... fit for royalty'; NoVA food couple Hypefoodies (~120K IG) put it on the map with a viral Eden Center reel. Open (Yelp, June 2026, 4.5+ across 170+ reviews).

dish: build-your-own halal meat bowls, chip-bag bowls, loaded fries
w: The DMV's most viral food phenomenon of 2024-25: a halal 'bring-your-own-bag-of-chips' bowl concept from recipe creator Shihan Chowdhury (@chilipeppercooks, ~1.8M TikTok) and Amgd Gende that drew lines down the block as a food truck and opened its first brick-and-mortar here in Annandale in July 2025. Northern Virginia Magazine's First Bite review said it 'lives up to its name'; WTOP called it the area's most viral culinary sensation; Keith Lee featured it on his DMV tour. Open and expanding (NoVA Mag, March 2026).

dish: build-your-own lemongrass-chicken bowls, kimchi cucumber salad
w: The Korean-Vietnamese build-your-own-bowl spot a local dubbed 'the Asian Chipotle,' turned a NoVA phenomenon after Keith Lee (~17M TikTok) opened his 2024 DMV tour here and rated the lemongrass chicken bowl 8.5/10 — the shop went from ~100 to nearly 1,000 orders a day. Covered by the Washington Post and WUSA9. Open (Yelp, July 2026, 160+ reviews).

dish: Asian-inspired cube croissants, supreme croissant, pandan/ube pastries
w: The viral Asian-inspired croissant bakery (cube croissants; the cream-filled 'Supreme'; cherry-blossom, pistachio-rose, ube flavors) that grew from NoVA farmers-markets to a Chantilly storefront and is opening a permanent Mosaic District space. Arlington Magazine's 'Eat This Now' spotlighted the croissants and NoVA food creator Sandie S. (@adorkandherfork, ~52K) reeled it to a wider audience. Open (Yelp, July 2026, 4.5+ across 120+ reviews).
